dex.text: A moth that looks like a bit of tree bark until it moves. Blends in beautifully on old woodland trunks, unless you happen to be a bird.
dex.fact: The dark form of the peppered moth became common in industrial areas such as Manchester in the 1800s, when soot darkened tree bark.

dex.text: Blackened by a century of smoke, it has never once apologised for the chimney. It considers itself a survivor, which is fair.
dex.fact: After smoke controls cleaned up British air in the 1950s and 1960s, the pale peppered moth became common again.
